about: Every number the aces-cad tests compare with. source is analytic (with its formula, checked against both probes when checked_by is present) or a probe made on 2026-10-10 by running the fixture scripts in tests/scripts with real build123d on the two platforms below. tol is {abs: x} or {rel: x}; null means exact. These are real measured outputs, not invented values.

probes.windows: probe 2026-10-10 Windows 11 workstation (cudax-sim-runtime .venv), Python 3.11.9, build123d 0.11.1, OCP 7.9.3.1, trimesh 5.1.0, numpy 2.4.6, ezdxf 1.4.4
probes.arch: probe 2026-10-10 archlinux:base on Docker Desktop (kernel 6.6.114.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2), aces-engineering 0.1.0-2 venv, Python 3.14.7, build123d 0.11.1, OCP 7.9.3.1, trimesh 5.1.0, numpy 2.4.6, ezdxf 1.4.4
